sections.heading: History
sections.text:
According to Sophie Casterwill, the spear at one time did hold the vampiric titan Antedeluvian, who later bonded with Vlad Dracul, the Impaler. [The Bookshop Hunter]

The Spear eventually fell into the hands of The Organization and was stored in Klaus' bookshop alongside the Bottle of Djinn. After outsmarting Klaus, Dante acquired the spear. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Dante used the Spear to allow him and the Huntik team entry into the castle by inserting into the wound of Vlad's statue. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Zhalia Moon used the Spear to allow the Blood Spiral entry to the castle after they had taken out the Huntik Foundation Operatives stationed outside the castle. [Lok's Leadership]
